summary: Frontend-only regression for the redesigned INTL Shipments page (unified hero card with priority strip + KPI rail, pipeline card with underline stage tabs, single-card Open Orders with recommended groups band, borderless mode bar). All target data-testids present and functional; all flows in the review request pass at 1920x1080 and 390x844 with zero console errors and no horizontal overflow.

verification_details.new_shipment_flow: is-create-modal opens, is-form-customer/is-form-factory fill, is-form-submit creates new shipment (IS-0013) and navigates to intl-shipment-detail; is-back returns

priority_strip.group_message_toggle: toggles (reply btn count stable while active messages remain)

critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 449 lines and contains both List + Detail + FACTORIES data + create modal; consider splitting Detail into its own file for maintainability.
Factories drawer and Create modal share the same .is-backdrop class without click-outside disambiguation; not a bug but worth centralizing into a single reusable component.
seed_data_creation: Transient shipment IS-0013 (TEST Customer Y / TEST Factory Y) created via create modal — in-memory only
context_for_next_testing_agent: All INTL Shipments redesign flows verified end-to-end in this run. Note: Factories drawer & Create modal are only closable by X button or clicking .is-backdrop (Escape key does NOT close them) — future playwright scripts should click .is-x rather than page.keyboard.press('Escape').
